trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum lands the moment the other 54 are earned. PowerPyx puts the full set at 4/10 and about 200 hours — GTA Vibes and GTA-Zone agree on both numbers — with one playthrough, no online trophies and no mission replay, so play the story first, clear optional missions as they appear, and follow the Roadmap page to see what is left.
steps: Play the story through Chapters 1-4 and the finale.
Clear optional missions and stranger chains when they appear — there is no mission replay.
Work the Roadmap stages in order until every row shows earned.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy that pops on its own. Play Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, through to the end — nothing else is needed. No community guide had more to add at launch beyond the mission name, so this one follows the official description.
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4.
Before the chapter ends, play the optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…” (see Maximum Withdrawal).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, say both PowerPyx and GTABase — but the bar is forgiving: PowerPyx puts the 100% checklist at roughly 60% of true completion, and GTA-Zone confirms nothing on it is missable. The checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) shows up after the story, yet everything done beforehand already counts. Most of it arrives through the other trophies; the grind is the checklist itself — 300 stunts, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars.
steps: Finish the story and the optional missions first.
Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story and work the remaining rows.
Scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
GTA-Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count. PowerPyx splits them into 130 Stunt Jumps over ramps, 202 Under the Bridges flights, 40 Knife Flights between buildings and 25 Base Jumps by parachute. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to farm them. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past 250 if A Long Road is the goal.
steps: Pick a stunt type and repeat it — any 250 of 397 count.
Fly under bridges for the fastest completions (202 available).
Keep going to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: One try at each of the 9 activity types is enough — no mastery needed. PowerPyx notes the tried types show at Touchpad > Progress > Activities. This one follows the official description plus the PSN counter of 9.
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see the 9 types.
Try each type once — a single attempt counts.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work down the range's challenge list one by one; the counter above tracks gold medals, and the notes field holds the ones that keep beating you. At launch no community source had confirmed range locations or per-challenge tips, so this guide follows the official description.
steps: Head to a Shooting Range and open its challenge list.
Play each of the 42 challenges until you hold gold on all of them.
Use the counter above to track golds; note the stubborn ones below.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 races run across them in total, per GTABase. Only one win per location is needed, so move on as soon as a location is won and come back for the rest later if you want them.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location.
Win one race there, then move to the next location.
Repeat until all 14 locations show a win.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida. Each distinct race counts once, so enter a variety instead of replaying one favourite. This one follows the official description plus the PSN counter of 20.
steps: Enter races across Leonida — street, off-road, water, air.
Win 20 different ones; repeats of a won race do not count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal, take his challenge, and out-fish him. At launch no community source had confirmed where Cal waits or what the challenge asks, so this guide follows the official description only.
steps: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge.
Out-fish him to win the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play a cabinet game through to its end. Any arcade game counts. This guide follows the official description only.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play one game through to completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Start his stranger chain as soon as it appears and keep returning to him — TechWiser reports stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, a claim from a single source that PowerPyx and GTABase do not confirm, so this is a watch item, not a confirmed missable. The guide follows the official description plus that watch note.
steps: Meet Andy when his stranger marker appears.
Finish his missions in order as they unlock.
Do his final mission before the story moves far past it.

Complete any 8 strands — the five partner finals plus three more.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.chapter: Chapter 1 — Lucia's balcony meditation, Jason's house
trophies.guide: The ONLY possibly missable trophy — PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer, OutputLag, GTA-Zone and GTA Vibes all flag it. Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia — meditating at a spot with both characters counts twice, per KeenGamer and GTABase. The first session is Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, and it is gone once Chapter 1 ends — whether the trophy needs it is still unconfirmed, so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. Counts differ by source: GTABase, KeenGamer and GTA-Zone list 18 spots, while the 100% checklist needs only 15 — this guide follows the 18 and the PSN counter of 18. OutputLag confirms the balcony session counts toward the total.
steps: In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house and follow her to the balcony — accept the meditation and do not leave Chapter 1 without it.
After the story, visit the remaining meditation spots across Leonida.
Meditate at each spot with both Jason and Lucia — every spot counts twice that way.
Track the counter in the Progress menu; keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops.
Meditate at all 18 spots; the counter above tracks them.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Which animal is unconfirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists this among the trophies with no confirmed trigger yet. Take Bret's hunt, track the animal he names, and take it down cleanly. The guide follows the official description plus the unconfirmed-trigger note.
steps: Meet Bret and take his hunt.
Track the unique animal he names.
Take it down to finish the hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Pick cards up scattered across Leonida and finish any three full sets — every set is not needed, just three. The guide follows the official description plus the PSN counter of 3.
steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore Leonida.
Complete any 3 full sets — three sets is enough.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. Open the WAiNK app and snap the marked locations as you travel — it stacks naturally with exploring the whole state for The Goodtime State. The guide follows the official description plus the PSN counter of 100.
steps: Open the WAiNK app at marked locations.
Snap 100 different locations across Leonida.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Open the Challenges list and clear 50 across its types — combat, driving, exploration and the rest. The 100% checklist asks for 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 if A Long Road is the goal. The guide follows the official description plus the PSN counter of 50.
steps: Open the Challenges list.
Clear 50 challenges across the types.
Keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. GTABase's route: build 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and get out of the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well for shaking the search. Both of you must be out of the heat when it clears.
steps: Bring your partner, then build a 4-star Wanted Level.
Break line of sight and leave the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works.
Stay clear until the stars drop.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. GTABase's route: the North Vice City jewelry stores sit close together, so rob three in a row while still wanted — and if the trophy does not pop after the third, rob a fourth. Keep your partner with you and do not let the wanted level drop between shops.
steps: Bring your partner and get wanted.
Rob three shops in a row — the North Vice City jewelry stores are close together.
If it does not pop after the third, rob a fourth without losing the wanted level.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. GTABase's method: scan them with WAiNK — there is no need to drive them — and scan traffic near busy roads, which is efficient. The counter above tracks your discoveries.
steps: Open WAiNK near traffic and scan unfamiliar vehicles.
Work busy roads for a steady stream of new models.
Scan 100 different vehicles — driving them is not required.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. GTABase's method: fill your Focus meter first, take an assault rifle, and find a group of gang members — cops, soldiers and civilians do not count. Trigger Focus with five gang members in range and drop them all before it ends.
steps: Fill your Focus meter before the fight.
Find a group of gang members with an assault rifle ready.
Trigger Combat Focus and drop 5 gang members in the one use.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal a docked passenger jet and fly about 1 km away from the airport, per GTABase. Board a jet sitting at a gate, get it moving, and put distance between you and VCIA.
steps: Get to VCIA and find a docked passenger jet.
Board it and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station, in the south of the map, and take out enemies from inside it. GTABase's route: drive through the gate or use the stunt jump to get into the base — the tanks are unlocked, so you can simply drive one away, which earns a 3-star wanted level. Deal with the responders from inside the Rhino.
steps: Get into Mile Zero Air Station — through the gate or over the stunt jump.
Steal an unlocked Rhino tank and drive it out (expect 3 stars).
Take out enemies from inside the tank.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. GTABase's route: slip in through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code, and clear the safe unseen — no alarms, no witnesses. If anyone spots you, leave and try another store.
steps: Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun.
Find the safe code inside.
Clear the safe unseen — no alarms, no witnesses.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.chapter: Chapter 4 — optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…”
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — and start with the optional Chapter 4 mission “That’s Where The Money Is…”, which this trophy requires and which cannot be replayed once Chapter 4 ends (PowerPyx Step 1: finish the story and complete the optional missions). GTABase's method for the vaults: follow a security van into a bank while the vault is open, expect a 4-star response, and keep a fast bike ready for the escape. Repeat for five vaults.
steps: In Chapter 4, do the optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…” — no mission replay, so do it now.
Follow a security van into a bank while the vault is open.
Clear the vault, expect 4 stars, and escape on a fast bike.
Repeat for 5 vaults in total.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop a truck on the road, take its cargo, and break away before the response boxes you in. The guide follows the official description only — no community source had confirmed a route at launch.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road and stop it.
Take its cargo.
Escape the response.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas on the PSN counter. GTABase's method: clear the fog over the whole map, and fly over the dark patches, which is the quickest way to uncover them. The counter above tracks areas visited.
steps: Open the map and note the dark, unexplored patches.
Fly over each dark patch to clear its fog.
Cover all 52 areas of Leonida.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang, nine in total, per GTABase. Find each gang's operation, hit it, and move to the next gang's territory. The counter above tracks gangs hit.
steps: Find an illegal operation in one gang's territory and rob it.
Move to the next gang and repeat.
Hit one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx counts this among the five trophies with NO confirmed trigger at launch — no community source had pinned down where or how it pops. This guide follows the official description only: go to Ocean Beach, find the cocktail spot with the view, and order one. Do not trust unverified methods.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find the cocktail spot with the view.
Order a cocktail there.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx counts this among the five trophies with NO confirmed trigger at launch — no community source had pinned down which showroom or what counts as classic style. This guide follows the official description only: take a vehicle inside a showroom and drive it straight out through the glass.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Get a vehicle inside it.
Smash out through the front in classic style.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. No community source had pinned down what the follow-through asks for at launch — PowerPyx lists this one as still unconfirmed too. This guide follows the official description only: go to the Kolt & Associates alley and bowl a full frame.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
Bowl a full frame and follow through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — the description hides the method, but GTABase's reported route is to max out Strength for both characters. Train Strength for Jason and for Lucia until both are maxed. Treat the route as early guidance: it comes from one guide's report, not from the official description.
steps: Train Strength for Jason until it is maxed.
Train Strength for Lucia until it is maxed.
The trophy should pop once both are at maximum.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile, per GTABase (single source). PowerPyx and GTABase both warn that “Irredeemable” is permanent — read a Criminal Profile guide before you go on a rampage, because some actions cannot be undone. The counter above tracks your 500.
steps: Open your Criminal Profile and see what moves it.
Take 500 actions that change the profile.
Check a Criminal Profile guide first — “Irredeemable” is permanent.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. PowerPyx counts this among the five trophies with NO confirmed trigger at launch — no community source had pinned down what must fail once and succeed the second time. This guide follows the official description only: retry something that failed once, and succeed on the second attempt. Do not trust unverified methods.
steps: Find an attempt that failed the first time.
Try it a second time and succeed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? PowerPyx counts this among the five trophies with NO confirmed trigger at launch — no community source had pinned down what strange thing must be witnessed. This guide follows the official description only: keep an eye out for something strange in the world and be there when it happens. Do not trust unverified methods.
steps: Explore Leonida and watch for something strange.
Be there when it happens.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. PowerPyx counts this among the five trophies with NO confirmed trigger at launch — no community source had pinned down the exact setup. This guide follows the official description only: from a moving vehicle, strike someone down with a melee weapon in a drive-by. Do not trust unverified methods.
steps: Get a vehicle moving past a target.
Strike them down with a melee weapon in a drive-by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. GTABase's method: launder the bills through fences — and one fence pays more than the rest, so use that one for the full $250,000. The counter above tracks dollars laundered.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and jobs.
Launder them through a fence — one fence pays the most.
Keep going until $250,000 is laundered.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts — clothes, weapons, food, vehicles — so big-ticket buys speed it up. The counter above tracks dollars spent. The guide follows the official description plus the PSN counter of $100,000.
steps: Spend across any shops in Leonida.
Big-ticket buys move the counter fastest.
Reach $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, about $160,000 in total, per GTABase. The 4 story garages do not count toward the 8, so buy the eight listed properties. The counter above tracks garages owned.
steps: Open the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy the 8 listed garage properties (about $160,000 total).
Story garages do not count — buy the eight on the app.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Bring ten different vehicles to Scooter Bros and register each one — any ten count. The guide follows the official description plus the PSN counter of 10.
steps: Bring a vehicle to Scooter Bros.
Register it in the app.
Repeat for 10 different vehicles.
